qualification: October 12 Shopping Brain fix and release

backend.integration: Normal merge preserved concurrent default-branch changes and restored unrelated local cron edits.

changes.cause: Greek comparison intent matched ποιο από inside κάποιο από. NFC could independently pass from a product title while the typed attribute remained unknown.
changes.repair: Bound the comparison phrase to a word boundary; require a known-true typed phone NFC attribute. Empty eligible comparisons now carry no_match status and an honest explanation. Existing bounded recommendation retrieval recovered eligible phones in live-catalog local replays.

changes.cause: The deterministic correction vocabulary omitted διόρθωση.
changes.repair: Recognize the explicit correction marker, preserving genuine contradictory-bound clarification. Same-turn and category-continuous history paths covered for both Brain channels.

changes.detail: record_low compares current price to the observed minimum with complete coverage. Brain compares price to the median in each usable window with a five-percent typical band. At 179.88 EUR, 30/90-day median 185.88 and 180-day median 188.68 are all inside that typical band; this can simultaneously be an observed record low. Multi-window boundary and mixed-window calibration tests added.

changes.repair: Removed transcript history from LobeHub, aligned search query maxLength to 400 and captured public input-schema parity fixtures. Nested native-launch discovery now derives the Zod input schema so defaulted evidence_detail stays optional. Website snapshot aligned.

changes.evidence: First exact-revision release run passed 14/15. The digital-subscription/gift-card request produced no_match with zero products but performed two searches.
changes.repair: A narrow whole-request digital-only check rejects explicit generic digital subscriptions and gift cards before reading or retrieval. Both channels, prior history, and physical-product/payment counterexamples are covered.

changes.finding: dense NFC evidence overflow found during final qualification
changes.repair: Increase the canonical claim-count bound from 2048 to 4096 while preserving the 1 MiB receipt bound, 48 candidates, 256 sources, complete claim references, typed evidence checks and all ten checked offers. No retrieval or model limits changed.
changes.causal_proof: A synthetic dense receipt failed at the old claim cap and passed after the change. The same live-catalog local replay retained 2065 claims in 770448 bytes and returned a valid NFC recommendation.
